title: An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Twilight stage and rig anticipation
scenes.purpose: Introduce the headline and the rigged character on a stationary twilight storybook stage, wound up in an anticipation pose.
visuals: Flat twilight sky bands, hills, moon, lamp light cone and grain stay still
Headline lines slide in from the left
Arm hangs at the 65-70 degree shoulder limit, the head dips and the torso squashes, then the shoulder sweeps up

beats.development: Headline reveals (0-0.65s) while the rig settles into anticipation: arm lowered, head tilted down, torso squashed, flat mouth C.
The shoulder swings up to 0 degrees and the elbow follows through with a small overshoot. Mouth swaps to replacement B, the legend selector moves to B and the dashed shoulder-limit arc draws.

scenes.title: The system assembles
scenes.purpose: Show the idea turning into a connected system from the pointing hand.
visuals: Cream link line draws from the hand
Four sage node tiles pop in with a light pulse and the edges connect

beats.development: The hand line draws to the first node and the panel wipes open. Mouth swaps to replacement A (smile), the first node pops in and a light pulse ring expands from it.
Edges draw outward, nodes two and three assemble, the closing edges draw and node four completes the loop. The head settles back to neutral and the eyes blink using replacement closed-eye artwork.

scenes.title: Settled reading hold
scenes.purpose: Hold the complete authored composition for reading.
visuals: Full scene at rest, matching the authored pose

beats.development: Everything is settled and readable: headline, smiling rig pointing at the network, legend with selector on A.
captions: MOUTH SWAPS A · B · C — shoulder limit 0°–70°

findings: All motion completes by 2.35s, before the 2.7s readability target.
The headline is fully visible by 0.65s, giving more than 2s of reading time.
justifiedHolds: 2.35-3.0s final hold lets the viewer read the complete scene.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.
No preview recipes are listed in STYLE.json; the preview demonstrates the core rig technique plus a scene-dependent twilight background drawn from the reviewed source frames.
